title: boehmeria taiwaniana var. pilushanensis
intro: Boehmeria taiwaniana var. pilushanensis, commonly known as Taiwan nettle, is a plant species in the nettle family (Urticaceae) native to Taiwan. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Taiwan nettle are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that may help to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antiviral activity. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Taiwan nettle for medicinal purposes.
